subject: Trillium private deploy intake: environment certification and egress checklist
messages:
From: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@trilliumht.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@trilliumht.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deploy intake — network certs & egress questions

Vanessa,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We're moving this to procurement next week and need to validate a few network/security prerequisites so our infra team can finish the firewall change request. Quick items we need for environment certification:

- Official IP ranges (primary + failover) that Redwood will use for outbound and inbound.
- TLS cert and CN expectations for service endpoints (we plan to terminate TLS at our LB).
- KMS/HSM integration footprint and whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys for data at rest.
- Audit / access logging retention and sample format for SOC evidence.
- Preferred port lists and any ephemeral port behavior we should allow for long polling/streaming.
- Suggested smoke-test schedule and rolling update maintenance window (we need a firm drop-dead date to align with our release).

I've attached our current network diagram and a short spreadsheet with fields for the values above — saving you the effort of re-typing. Can you confirm which items require vendor (Redwood) attestation vs. just configuration documentation?

Appreciate the speedy turnaround — procurement wants this by EOD Wednesday.

Best,
Samir Kapoor
VP Engineering, Trillium HealthTech
Attachment: TRI-network-diagram.pdf (diagram, 1 page)
Attachment: TRI-onboarding-answers.xlsx (template)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@trilliumht.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@trilliumht.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy intake — network certs & egress questions

Hi Samir — thanks for the detailed list and the diagram. Looping in Ben (sales) for procurement timing and Karthik for the infra specifics.

Immediate answers up front:
- We will provide an official set of IP ranges for both control-plane and egress (CIDR blocks) — Karthik will paste the exact list below.
- Redwood supports customer-managed KMS keys for Private deployments (we integrate with most KMS/HSM providers; attestation is a configuration doc + KMS proof-of-ownership step).
- Audit logs: we retain request-level access logs for 90 days by default; extended retention is an add-on — we can provide a sample log export in JSON/CSV for SOC evidence.
- Ports: 443 outbound for control plane; a small range for health/telemetry egress (we'll include the exact ports). Streaming uses standard TLS over 443 (no additional ephemeral open ports needed on your firewall).

I've attached our Private onboarding checklist and a network-template YAML you can drop into your infra ticket.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Fill the spreadsheet you attached with the subnet allocation you plan to use and return it.
2) Confirm preferred maintenance window (we usually propose Sun 02:00–04:00 local).
3) Ben to confirm procurement SLA/credits if needed.

Ben / Karthik — anything to add?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-private-onboard-checklist.pdf
Attachment: redwood-network-template.yaml
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@trilliumht.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@trilliumht.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy intake — network certs & egress questions

Samir / team — adding the infra specifics here so you can paste into your firewall ticket and change control:

- Control-plane outbound CIDRs (Redwood-managed): 52.203.18.0/24, 18.214.10.0/24, 3.110.77.0/24 (primary).
- Egress (data-plane) public IP pool used for tokenized callbacks / webhooks: 34.82.160.0/20.
- Inbound (if you choose to configure direct callbacks): we recommend using your LB to terminate TLS and forward to private IPs; Redwood will provide the planned /32 addresses for any IP allowlist once the account is provisioned.
- TLS: we accept any CA-signed cert for CN matching your hostname; SAN entries are fine. If you need us to host certs we can, but for private deployments customers usually bring their own certs.
- KMS: we support AWS KMS (CMKs) and several HSMs via PKCS#11 — the integration requires an IAM role and an endpoint. We'll provide the exact provisioning doc in the onboarding folder.
- Audit logs: sample format attached in the onboarding checklist.
- Ports: 443 (control/data), 2200 (optional SSH jump for emergency support — only enabled with explicit customer approval), 9000–9010 (telemetry, optional).

Operational note: for the smoke test we need an API token with restricted scope and a small test dataset (non-PHI). Suggest scheduling a 60-min window where we run a few scripted requests and validate latencies + logs.

If you can send the filled spreadsheet and a preferred maintenance window I can lock the IP assignments and open the provisioning ticket.

—Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@trilliumht.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@trilliumht.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2028 14:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy intake — network certs & egress questions

Thanks Karthik — that's great. We've filled the spreadsheet and attached it (TRI-onboarding-answers.xlsx). Highlights:
- We'll use 10.12.0.0/20 for the tenant subnet.
- Maintenance window: Sunday 02:00–04:00 PT looks good.
- We'll provide a non-PHI test dataset and a service account for the smoke tests.
- For KMS we'll plan to use AWS KMS with a customer-managed CMK; Sam and I will coordinate IAM access.

Questions:
1) Can you confirm the escalation path if the smoke test shows degraded throughput — who do we page and what's the SLA on rollback?
2) For audit log delivery — can Redwood push daily exports to our S3 bucket or do we pull from an API?

Attachment: TRI-onboarding-answers.xlsx

—Samir
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@trilliumht.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@trilliumht.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy intake — network certs & egress questions

Samir — perfect, thanks for the worksheet and clear answers. Quick replies to your questions plus final checklist before we open provisioning: 

1) Escalation & rollback: primary on-call is Karthik (infra) — page: infra-oncall@redwood.com; secondary is Vanessa (solutions). If smoke shows degraded throughput we follow our canary rollback policy: immediate stop + revert to prior model variant; target time-to-rollback is 15 minutes for Private Dedicated instances (we'll document exact steps in the runbook we'll hand over). We will also include a phone number for urgent pages in the provisioning ticket.

2) Audit logs: Redwood can push daily encrypted exports to your S3 via cross-account role. We'll include the CloudFormation snippet for the role in the onboarding folder. Pull API is also available if you prefer pulling.

Final checklist before provisioning ticket: 
- Confirm tenant subnet (received).
- Confirm maintenance window (received).
- Confirm CMK ARN and IAM role for KMS access (please share when ready).
- Confirm S3 bucket ARN for audit exports (or we will provide push instructions).
- Label the smoke-test dataset as non-PHI and share credentials.

If you sign off here I'll:
- Open the provisioning ticket and attach the IP assignments.
- Schedule the smoke test for Sun 22 Jul 2028 02:00 PT (provisioning dependent).
- Provide a short runbook + phone numbers for escalation.

Maya / Ben — anything on procurement or credits we should note?

Thanks — looking forward to the go-ahead.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0182
Attachment: (runbook to be added to provisioning ticket)
